basic_profile.bio: Avid rollercoaster enthusiast and thrill-seeker from the Midwest, USA. I have a passion for theme parks and spend my weekends planning trips to new coasters. Aside from my love for adrenaline-pumping rides, I'm a tech consultant focusing on software solutions for small businesses. My evenings are often spent engaging with fellow enthusiasts online. I enjoy long road trips, meeting new people at coaster conventions, and have a soft spot for vintage vinyl records. Currently in a long-term relationship, and always on the lookout for the next big coaster adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in rollercoasters stems from over a decade of personal experience visiting countless theme parks across the country. I actively participate in enthusiast forums and have written several guest articles for coaster magazines. My background in technology allows me to stay updated with the latest advancements in ride safety and engineering.
